name: abhas
description: Abhas — ward-level dengue early warning (FastAPI + LightGBM API, Next.js dashboard)

scripts.setup:dev: npm run setup && cd apps/api && uv sync --python 3.12
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../.. && npm --prefix apps/web run lint --if-present
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && uv run pyright && cd ../.. && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:contract: node .orca-team/tools/with-server.mjs --env RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=10000 -- uvx schemathesis run {API}/openapi.json --checks all --exclude-checks positive_data_acceptance --max-examples 25
scripts.eval: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.run --split heldout
scripts.eval:dev: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.run --split dev
scripts.eval:baseline: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.run --split all --tag baseline
scripts.eval:lock: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.run --lock
scripts.eval:retrieval: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.retrieval
scripts.redteam: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.redteam
scripts.load: node .orca-team/tools/with-server.mjs --env RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=10000 -- k6 run -e API={API} tests/load/smoke.js
scripts.check:traces: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -q -m tracing
scripts.test:offline:api: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const env={...process.env,ABHAS_OFFLINE:'1'}; for (const cmd of ['uv run pytest -q -m offline','uv run pytest -q']) { const r=spawnSync(cmd,{cwd:'apps/api',shell:true,stdio:'inherit',env}); if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status??1); }"
scripts.test:offline:web: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const env={...process.env,ABHAS_OFFLINE:'1',NEXT_PUBLIC_ABHAS_OFFLINE:'1'}; const r=spawnSync('npm --prefix apps/web run e2e -- --project=offline',{shell:true,stdio:'inherit',env}); process.exit(r.status??1);"
scripts.offline:check: npm run test:offline:api && npm run test:offline:web
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke:local
